description: Fields common to all digital signature types (PDF CAdES/PKCS#7 and ADOC XAdES).

signerCN.description: Common Name from the signer's certificate subject (typically the signer's full name), or null if the certificate was not embedded or the CN field was absent

signerEmail.description: Email address from the certificate subject (E= / emailAddress=) or Subject Alternative Name, or null if absent

signerCountry.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code from the C= field of the signer's certificate, or null if absent

hasPersonalId.description: True if the certificate serialNumber field contains a Lithuanian personal identity number (11-digit asmens kodas or PNOLT- passport number). The number itself is never stored.

signingTime.description: Claimed signing timestamp as ISO 8601, or null if absent. Source varies by format: XAdES SigningTime element for ADOC, pdfsig output for PDF.

hashAlgorithm.description: Human-readable hash algorithm name (e.g. 'SHA-256', 'SHA-512'), or null if unknown

isValid.description: true = signature is cryptographically valid, false = invalid, null = not validated at extraction time
